title: Runway closures (NOTAMs)
blurb: LGA's only into-wind runway closed, DEN down to 2 of 6 runways, an MSP runway closed for weeks.
description: Clear weather. NOTAMs close LGA runway 4/22 while a 040° wind at 18 kt makes it the runway lined up with the wind (Moderate), four of DEN's six runways (Moderate), and MSP runway 12R/30L plus taxiway C (Low; the taxiway is information only).

assert.re: ^Runway 4/22 closed until .* — the runway best lined up with the wind$
